title: Peacemakers … how?
excerpt: This short video from Dan Shapiro of Harvard offers some excellent insight into peacemaking (which he calls “negotiating”): Appreciation, autonomy, affiliation, status, and role … five concerns that all participants in a conflict share.
body:
This short video from Dan Shapiro of Harvard offers some excellent insight into peacemaking (which he calls “negotiating”):

Appreciation, autonomy, affiliation, status, and role … five concerns that all participants in a conflict share.
